item.title: This 4,000-year-old city defied the rules of history
item.description: Mohenjo-daro thrived while reducing inequality, with shared infrastructure and fair trade systems.

item.title: A forgotten fossil just revealed a new Triassic predator from 210 million years ago
item.description: A fossil overlooked for 80 years reveals a new crocodile relative from 210 million years ago in New Mexico.

item.title: NSF invests $108M in six materials science centers to advance future technologies
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation is funding six research centers with $108 million to push materials science beyond current limits.

item.title: Galápagos plants reveal evolution repeating itself
item.description: More than 150 years after Darwin's finches, giant daisies in the Galápagos show another evolutionary pattern repeating.
